data.name: Natal
data.gender_notes: Natal is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin natalis, meaning ‘birthday’ or ‘reborn’. In Christian tradition, the name Natal represents new beginnings and the joy of a fresh start. The name Natal carries the meaning “Reborn” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Natal usually hope their child will grow to embody reborn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of rebirth and renewal.
data.etymology: Natal belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reborn.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Natal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
